A contract logistics business manages warehousing, transport, and supply-chain services for other companies under contract.
control panels concept
Control panels are management screens attackers or administrators use to configure systems and view activity.
Control plane concept
A control plane is the part of a system that manages configuration, decisions, and coordination rather than carrying user data.
Controller concept
A controller is a component that manages or directs how other parts of a system behave.
conversation exfiltration technique
Conversation exfiltration means secretly stealing chat messages or conversation history from an app or service.
coordination concept
Coordination is the organized sharing of tasks, information, and decisions among people or teams.
Copilot product
Copilot is Microsoft's AI assistant built into various Microsoft products to help with tasks like writing, searching, and coding.
Copilot+ PCs product
A category of Windows PCs with dedicated AI hardware, branded as 'Copilot+ PCs,' which may have unique security features or vulnerabilities.
Copilot+ PCs product
A category of Windows PCs with dedicated AI hardware, branded as 'Copilot+ PCs,' which may have unique security features or vulnerabilities.
CornFlake malware
CornFlake is a named malware family or malicious tool referenced in security reporting.
corporate network concept
A corporate network is the private collection of computers, servers, and systems used by an organization.
Corporate resources concept
Corporate resources are company-owned systems, data, applications, and services employees use for work.
corroborating signals concept
Corroborating signals are multiple pieces of evidence that support the same conclusion, such as several alerts all pointing to the same attack.
CPU concept
A CPU is the main processor in a computer that runs instructions and performs calculations.
crafted HTTP request technique
A crafted HTTP request is a specially made web request designed to trigger a bug or unusual behavior in a server.
Crafted packet technique
A crafted packet is a specially made network message designed to test, exploit, or confuse a system.
crafted packets technique
Crafted packets are specially made network messages designed to trigger a bug, bypass a check, or test a system.
credential brute-forcing technique
Credential brute-forcing is trying many username and password combinations until one works.
credential exposure concept
Credential exposure means usernames, passwords, keys, or tokens have been revealed where attackers may be able to use them.
Credential interception technique
Credential interception is stealing usernames, passwords, tokens, or other login secrets while they are being entered or transmitted.
credential theft technique
Credential theft is the stealing of usernames, passwords, tokens, or other login information.
credential-dumping technique
Credential-dumping is stealing stored usernames, passwords, or login tokens from a computer or system.
credential-harvesting
Credential harvesting is collecting usernames, passwords, or login tokens from victims.
credentials concept
Credentials are login details or access tokens that prove a user or system is allowed to access something.
Credit and business identifiers concept
Credit and business identifiers are numbers or records used to identify people or companies for financial, credit, tax, or commercial purposes.
critical infrastructure concept
Critical infrastructure refers to essential systems and services that societies and organizations depend on.
also: critical infrastructure sectors
critical remote code execution vulnerability
Critical remote code execution is a severe security flaw that lets an attacker run code on a system from afar.
critical vulnerabilities vulnerability
Critical vulnerabilities are very serious security flaws that could let attackers cause major damage or gain major access.
Critical vulnerability vulnerability
A critical vulnerability is a very serious security flaw that can cause major damage if exploited.
CRM concept
CRM stands for customer relationship management, which refers to systems and data used to manage sales and customer interactions.
CRM user profiles concept
CRM user profiles are customer relationship management records that store details about users, customers, or contacts.
cross-platform campaigns technique
Cross-platform campaigns are attacks designed to work against more than one operating system or device type.

Cross-site scripting is a website vulnerability that lets attackers run malicious scripts in other users’ browsers.
crowdstrike organization
CrowdStrike is a cybersecurity company known for endpoint protection, threat intelligence, and incident response.
cryptbase.dll tool
cryptbase.dll is a legitimate Windows cryptography-related library that malware may reference or abuse.
cryptocurrency concept
Cryptocurrency is digital money, such as Bitcoin, that uses cryptography and usually runs on a blockchain.

A cryptographic key is a secret value used to lock or unlock encrypted information.
CSV concept
CSV can mean comma-separated values, a simple spreadsheet-like file format, or cluster shared volumes in Windows clustering depending on context.
Cumulative updates concept
Cumulative updates are software updates that include current fixes plus earlier fixes in one package.
curl
curl is a command-line tool used to transfer data to or from servers using protocols like HTTP and HTTPS.
cursor
Cursor is an AI-assisted code editor built for software developers.
Curve25519 protocol
Curve25519 is a widely used cryptographic curve for creating secure encryption keys and digital key exchanges.
customer data concept
Customer data is information a company keeps about its customers, such as names, contact details, or purchase history.
customer information concept
Customer information is data a business keeps about its customers, such as names, contact details, purchases, or account records.
customer telemetry concept
Customer telemetry is usage, event, or security data collected from customer systems to help monitor performance, behavior, or threats.
also: real customer telemetry

CVE records concept
CVE records are public entries that identify and describe known cybersecurity vulnerabilities.
CVEs concept
CVEs are standardized public identifiers for known cybersecurity vulnerabilities.
CVSS concept
CVSS is a standard scoring system used to rate how severe a software vulnerability is.
also: CVSS scoring system
CVSS base score concept
A CVSS base score is a number from 0 to 10 that summarizes how severe a security vulnerability is.
CVSS score concept
A CVSS score is a standard number used to show how severe a software vulnerability is.
CVSS v3.1 concept
CVSS v3.1 is a standard scoring system used to describe how serious a software vulnerability is.
CVSSv3 concept
CVSSv3 is version 3 of a scoring system used to rate how severe a software vulnerability is.

CWE-787 is a software weakness category for writing data past the end of a memory buffer, which can crash programs or enable attacks.
cyber concept
Cyber is a broad shorthand for things related to computers, networks, and digital security.
cyber capabilities concept
Cyber capabilities are the tools, skills, access, and processes an organization or country can use in cyberspace.
Cyber disruptions concept
Cyber disruptions are interruptions to normal operations caused by digital failures, attacks, outages, or security incidents.
Cyber frontier models concept
Cyber frontier models are advanced AI models designed or evaluated for high-level cybersecurity tasks such as finding flaws or analyzing attacks.
cyber incidents concept
Cyber incidents are events that threaten or harm computer systems, networks, or data.
cyber resilience concept
Cyber resilience is an organization's ability to keep operating and recover quickly when cyberattacks or failures happen.
cyberattack concept
A cyberattack is an attempt to damage, disrupt, or gain unauthorized access to computer systems or data.
cyberattacks concept
Malicious activities conducted over computer networks to steal data, disrupt operations, or damage systems.
cybercriminals threat-actor
Cybercriminals are people who use computers or the internet to commit crimes such as fraud, theft, or extortion.
Cybersecurity concept
Cybersecurity is the practice of protecting computers, networks, software, and data from digital attacks or misuse.
Cybersecurity coordination concept
Cybersecurity coordination is the organized sharing of roles, information, and actions among teams or organizations during security work or incidents.
Cybersecurity disruption concept
Cybersecurity disruption is an incident that interrupts normal digital systems or security operations.
cybersecurity incident concept
A cybersecurity incident is an event that threatens the security of systems, networks, or data.
cybersecurity researchers organization
Cybersecurity researchers are people who study digital threats, software flaws, and attacks to help protect systems.
CyCognito organization
CyCognito is a cybersecurity company known for external attack surface management technology.
data encryption concept
Data encryption is the process of transforming data so it cannot be read without the right key.
data exfiltration technique
Data exfiltration is the unauthorized removal or copying of data from a system.
data exposure concept
Data exposure means sensitive information is left accessible to people or systems that should not be able to see it.
data extortion group threat-actor
A data extortion group is a criminal group that steals or claims to steal data and demands payment to avoid leaking it.
data leak concept
A data leak is when private or sensitive information is exposed to people who should not have it.

data schemas concept
Data schemas are agreed layouts that describe what fields data should contain and how those fields should be formatted.
Data tables concept
Data tables are structured sets of information arranged in rows and columns, often inside databases or spreadsheets.
data theft concept
Data theft is the stealing of information from a system or service.
Database credentials concept
Database credentials are usernames, passwords, keys, or tokens used to access a database.
Daybreak Blue product
Daybreak Blue is a named entity referenced in security reporting, likely a campaign, service, or operation label used to distinguish one activity set from others.
Daybreak Red product
Daybreak Red is a named entity referenced in security reporting, likely a campaign, service, or operation label used to distinguish one activity set from others.
DDoS technique

De Bijenkorf organization
De Bijenkorf is a Dutch department store chain that may be referenced as an organization or impersonated brand in security reporting.
Deadlock concept
A deadlock is a situation where two or more processes are stuck waiting for each other and cannot continue.

DeadLock ransomware is a ransomware family referenced in security reporting that encrypts victims' files and demands payment.
also: DeadLock ransomware operation
Deauthentication technique

Debian product
A well-known community-driven Linux distribution famous for its stability and package management system.
Debug technique
